key_quotes: We are increasing our infrastructure CapEx forecast for this year. Most of that is due to higher component costs, particularly memory pricing.
We anticipate 2026 capital expenditures to be in the range of $125 billion-$145 billion, increased from our prior range of $115 billion-$135 billion.
